title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: At roughly 350 words, the question is far over the 120-word limit.
It gives a recommendation (option 1) but never says what the harness will do by default if no answer comes.
Internal ids and jargon appear without plain explanation: T5KJ6J2, t010/t009, LIST_BUDGET, PAGE_SIZE, triggerType, worktree, 'implement step', 'budget'.
The task itself is never stated plainly. A reader has to work out that it is about adding two fields to a task-list response that has a byte size limit.
It does explain why the question exists: the brief's required fields push the response past the 2400-byte limit.
The options do describe their consequences (byte sizes, a lost field, extra calls, a changed limit).
